origin.says: 𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 喿 (chirping) as the sound: feet that cannot keep still, restless and rash.

ety.hint: Grains of hair 禾 on a person's head 几

origin.says: Originally 毛 (hair) above 儿 (a person): a person whose hair is thin, bald. 毛 later turned into 禾 (grain) and 儿 into 几.

呕.def: to vomit; to annoy, to enrage

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 区 (district) as the sound: to vomit. Simplified from 嘔 by the shorthand 区.

呕.name: vomit

origin.says: From 腎: 臤 (firm) as the sound plus ⺼ (flesh) for the meaning: the kidney. 臤 was simplified, its 臣 (servant) becoming two short strokes.

ety.hint: A person 亻 with more than they need 多

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 多 (many) as the sound: a person spreading wealth about, lavish, extravagant; the sense of 'much' also helps.
王 (jade) for the meaning plus 册 (book) as the sound: coral, treated as a precious stone.

ety.hint: To pace 彳 back and forth 回; 回 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 彳 (step, walking) for the meaning plus 回 (to turn back) as sound and meaning: walking back and forth, to linger. It began as a variant of 回 (return).
彳 (step) for the meaning plus 非 as the sound: to step back and forth, to pace, to hesitate.

峙.def: to pile, to stack; to stand tall

ety.hint: A swallow, with its head 廿, wings 北, and tail 灬

origin.says: A picture of a swallow: the head on top (now like 廿, twenty), the body with spread wings (now like 北, north) and the forked tail (now like 灬, fire).
Simplified from 謙: 言 (speech) became 讠. 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 兼 (both) as the sound: modest in speech, 'humble'.
A drawing of two bamboo stalks with drooping leaves: bamboo.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 桑 (mulberry) as the sound: the throat, the voice.

ety.hint: A caring relationship between two 二 people 亻

origin.says: 亻 (person) as the sound plus 二 (two) for the meaning: the bond between two people, kindness, humaneness.
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 加 (add) as the sound: a plant name, now 'eggplant'.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 宁 (calm), from 寧, as the sound, used for the lemon tree. Simplified from 檸.

渊.def: abyss, depth; to surge up, to bubble up

origin.says: From 淵: the right side is a picture of a basin with swirling water between banks; 氵 (water) was added later: a deep pool, abyss. The simplified form drew the inside as 米.

渊.name: abyss

origin.says: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 留 (stay) as the sound: the pomegranate tree.

潘.def: a river that flows into the Han; surname

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 番 (turn) as the sound: the name of a river (also said to be water used to wash rice); now mainly a surname.

潘.name: pan river

憎.def: to abhor, to detest, to hate

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 曾 (once before) as the sound: a feeling that builds up, to hate.

憎.name: hate

origin.says: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 蒙 (cover) as the sound: a kind of tree; today mostly in the word for lemon.

曙.def: dawn, daybreak; the dawn of an era

origin.says: 日 (sun) for the meaning plus 署 as the sound: the first light of the sun, dawn. One source names 暑 (summer heat) as the sound part instead.

曙.name: first light

origin.says: Simplified from 鏟: 金 (metal) became 钅 and 產 became 产. 钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 产 (produce) as the sound: 'shovel, spade'.
豙 (an angry boar) as the sound and meaning plus 殳 (weapon in hand): fierce and firm, resolute.
爻 (crossed lines) as the sound plus ⺼ (meat) for the meaning: cooked meat dishes. The lower cross of 爻 slid down beside the flesh, so it now looks like 乂 (cut) on top of 有 (have).
页 (head) for the meaning plus 巠 (warp threads) as the sound: the neck, the straight stem holding up the head. Simplified from 頸 by writing 巠 as 𢀖 and 頁 (head) as 页.

吩.def: to order, to command; to instruct

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 分 (divide) as the sound: to tell someone what to do, instruct.

吩.name: bidding

毙.def: to kill; to die a violent death

origin.says: Simplified from 斃: 敝 (worn out) as the sound over 死 (death) for the meaning. The simplified form replaces 敝 with the simpler sound part 比 (compare). To die a violent death, to shoot dead.

毙.name: violent death

origin.says: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 肃 (solemn) as the sound: a wormwood plant, later bleak, desolate. Simplified from 蕭 by shortening 肅. One source swaps which part gives the sound.
广 (wide building) for the meaning plus 郭 (outer wall) as the sound: wide, open; an outline.

趟.def: time, occasion; to make a journey

origin.says: A late character: 走 (walk) for the meaning plus 尚 (esteem) as the sound: a trip, a time going somewhere.

趟.name: trip

憋.def: to stifle, to restrain, to choke; to suppress one's inner feelings

origin.says: 敝 (tattered) as the sound plus 心 (heart) for the meaning: feelings held in, stifled, choked.

憋.name: hold in

髦.def: fashionable, in vogue; mane, flowing hair

ety.hint: Birds 隹 caught in a sudden storm 雨

origin.says: Birds 隹 (bird) under 雨 (rain); old forms had two or three birds: birds taking off fast in the rain, hence the whirr, quickly.
钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 丐 (beggar) as the sound: a modern coinage for the element calcium. 釒 (metal) is shortened to 钅.

ety.hint: Words 讠 of warning 戒; 戒 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 言 (speech) plus 戒 (to guard against), which gives both sound and meaning: words that warn. Simplified from 誡.

ety.hint: Water 氵 going in all directions 行

origin.says: 行 (road, to go) with 水 (water) inside it: water spreading along its course, to overflow, to spread out.

乒.def: used with pong for ping pong

ety.hint: A ball bouncing back and forth; compare 乓

origin.says: A late-made character: 兵 (soldier) with its right foot stroke dropped, used for the sound 'ping'; with its mirror 乓 (pong) it writes ping-pong.

乒.name: ping

乓.def: used with ping for ping pong

ety.hint: A ball bouncing back and forth; compare 乒

origin.says: A late-made character: 兵 (soldier) with its left foot stroke dropped, used for the sound 'pong'; with its mirror 乒 (ping) it writes ping-pong.

乓.name: pong

origin.says: 雨 (rain, weather) for the meaning plus 相 (mutual) as the sound: frost.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 矞 (to pierce) as the sound: the tangerine tree and its fruit.

竭.def: to exhaust; to put forth great effort

origin.says: 立 (to stand) for the meaning plus 曷 (why) as the sound: first to carry or hold up, then to use up all one's strength, to exhaust.
origin.src: Wiktionary; Dong Chinese; own knowledge for the first sense

竭.name: exhaust

拷.def: to torture, to interrogate; to beat, to flog

ety.hint: To question 考 by hand 扌; 考 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 考 (examine) as the sound: to beat during questioning, torture.

拷.name: flog

扛.def: to lift; to carry on one's shoulders

ety.hint: Labor 工 done by hand 扌; 工 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 工 (work) as the sound: to lift, to carry on the shoulder.

扛.name: shoulder lift

origin.says: 匚 (box) plus 斤 (axe): a carpenter with his tool box, a craftsman. One reading takes 匚 as the sound instead; both keep the same parts.
阝 (hill) for the meaning plus 益 (increase) as the sound: a narrow pass between hills, hence narrow.
钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 垂 (droop) as the sound: a hammer, a metal weight. Simplified from 錘 (金 to 钅).
米 (rice) for the meaning plus 造 (build) as the sound: coarse, unpolished rice, hence rough.

浇.def: to spray, to sprinkle, to water

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 尧 (lofty) as the sound: to pour water over, to sprinkle, to water plants. Simplified from 澆, with 堯 written as 尧.

浇.name: water plants

吟.def: to sing, to hum; to recite; a type of poetry

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 今 (now) as the sound: to chant, recite, or moan.

吟.name: chant

ety.hint: A bow aimed to the left

origin.says: A picture of a bow for shooting arrows; by extension anything curved.

弓.name: bow
弓.in: 强张湾引弹弱涨弥弯弦粥疆躬溺蚓弘弛弧

origin.says: One reading: 北 (two people back to back) with a top part, meaning 'contrary, perverse'; the sense later turned to 'well-behaved, clever'. The build is unclear in the modern shape.
火 (fire) for the meaning plus 巨 (huge) as the sound: a torch.
Simplified from 醞: 酉 (wine jar) for the meaning plus 昷 as the sound, swapped for 云 (cloud), which sounds close: to brew, ferment.
Simplified from 顫: 亶 (sincere) as the sound plus 頁 (head) for the meaning: the head shaking, to tremble; 頁 became 页.

ety.hint: A bow 弓 and arrow 土 used to defend a border 畺; 畺 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 彊 (strong) as the sound; 畺 inside shows fields with boundary lines: the boundary, frontier.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 宗 (clan) as the sound: the hemp palm, whose fibre is brown. Originally written 椶, whose sound part was later replaced by 宗.
艹 (grass, plants) for the meaning plus 分 (divide) as the sound: the scent given off by plants, fragrance.
目 (eye) for the meaning plus 登 (climb) as the sound: eyes opened wide, to stare or glare.

ety.hint: A city 阝 guarding a pass 关

origin.says: From 鄭: 奠 (offering) as the sound plus 阝 (city) for the meaning, the name of an old state, now a surname. Simplification replaced 奠 with the shape 关 (pass).

ety.hint: A hill 阝 where people are laid to rest 夌; 夌 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 阝 (mound) for the meaning plus 夌 (to climb over) as sound and meaning: a big hill, then an emperor's burial mound.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 查 (check) as the sound: what settles out of liquid, dregs.

呻.def: to moan, to groan; to chant

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 申 (extend) as the sound: a drawn-out sound from the mouth, to groan.

呻.name: groan

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 至 (arrive) as the sound. It replaced 姪 (nephew, with 女 woman) and now means nephew.

ety.hint: Two eyes, one open 目 and one shut 乏

origin.says: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 乏 (lacking) as the sound: to blink or wink.
宀 (roof) for the meaning plus 肖 as the sound (肖 may itself first have meant night): night, time under the roof.

屑.def: bits, crumbs, scraps; fragments; not worthwhile

origin.says: 尸 (body) with 肖 as the sound: bits, crumbs, scraps; also 'not worth the trouble'. It was first written another way, so the build is not certain.

屑.name: crumbs

赦.def: to forgive, to pardon, to remit

origin.says: 攵 (hand with a stick) for the meaning plus 赤 (red) as the sound, which replaced an older sound part 亦 (also): to let off, to pardon.

赦.name: amnesty

ety.hint: Something wrapped 伏 in cloth 衤; 伏 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 衤 (clothing) for the meaning plus 伏 (crouch) as the sound: a cloth used to wrap things up, a bundle wrapper.

劈.def: to chop, to cut apart; to split

origin.says: 辟 (law) as the sound plus 刀 (knife) for the meaning: to chop or split apart.

劈.name: chop apart

掷.def: to throw, to hurl, to fling, to cast

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 郑 (Zheng state) as the sound: to throw, to fling. Simplified from 擲.

掷.name: hurl
